description: This file defines data structures and a singleton class for managing and tracking instances (nodes) within an application, including network presence, health status, and notifications. It includes imports of Cocoa, Foundation, and specific frameworks related to observation and OpenClaw protocols.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the state of instances, handles presence updates via push notifications, performs periodic refreshes, and notifies about node connections.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh and presence update listening, unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing refresh and presence update tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches presence data from the control channel, decodes it, and updates internal state.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a local fallback InstanceInfo object with system details.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push notifications related to presence or snapshot events.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and updates internal state.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and processes presence event payloads received from push notifications.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts presence entries into normalized InstanceInfo objects.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Applies a list of presence entries to update the current state and triggers notifications for node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends notifications when nodes connect, avoiding duplicates and filtering local modes.
